name: dogfood-kafka-event-pipeline
description: Dogfood app (v1.20-2) — a Kafka event pipeline that exercises 4 patterns (idempotent producer with partition key + batch / consumer group with offset commit + rebalance callback / exactly-once transactional producer + read-committed consumer / DLQ with retry policy + poison message quarantine + DLQ topic subscribe) driven by @kiwa-test/streaming in KIWA_MODE=mock and kafkajs against a real Kafka broker in KIWA_MODE=real (env-skip KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/streaming -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
